cases.planted: slidingWindow.Add in circuit_breaker.go computes bucketDuration := sw.interval / time.Duration(len(sw.values)) and then divides elapsed / bucketDuration. When the interval is shorter than the number of buckets (for example a circuit breaker built with resetTimeout 0, or an interval of a few nanoseconds), bucketDuration is 0 and the first recorded request panics with an integer divide by zero. The fix only advances the window when bucketDuration > 0.

cases.summary: fix(retry): protect parseRetryAfterHeader from integer and time duration overflow
cases.planted: parseRetryAfterHeader in retry.go reads the clock twice: retryTime.Before(timeNow()) and then retryTime.Sub(timeNow()). The fix clamps the negative duration to 0.

cases.planted: With precompressed: true, serveStatic parses Accept-Encoding by splitting on ',' and trimming, then keeps only entries exactly equal to br, zstd or gzip.
